=== FILE: verification_plan.json ===
{
  "format": "nirmaan.vplan",
  "version": 1,
  "requirements": [
    {"id": "IRQ-PARAM", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "1. Parameters", "text": "The block works for every `N` from 2 to 32, and bits `N` and up of the `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` registers read as zero and ignore writes."},
    {"id": "IRQ-RESET", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "text": "While `rst_n` is low at a rising edge of `clk`, `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` clear to zero and the remembered level of every source clears to zero."},
    {"id": "IRQ-REG-RW", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "text": "A write to `ENABLE` or `MODE` stores `wdata` bits `N-1` to 0 in that register."},
    {"id": "IRQ-READ", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "text": "A read never changes any register; `rdata` follows `addr` with no clock edge."},
    {"id": "IRQ-LEVEL", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.2 Detection", "text": "A high-level source sets its `PENDING` bit at every rising edge where its input is high."},
    {"id": "IRQ-EDGE", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.2 Detection", "text": "A rising-edge source sets its `PENDING` bit at a rising edge where its input is high and was low at the previous rising edge, so an input held high sets it once."},
    {"id": "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.2 Detection", "text": "Detection does not depend on `ENABLE`: a disabled source still sets its `PENDING` bit."},
    {"id": "IRQ-W1C", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.3 Clearing", "text": "A write to `PENDING` clears each bit written 1 and leaves each bit written 0 unchanged; it never sets a bit."},
    {"id": "IRQ-ACK", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.3 Clearing", "text": "A write to `CLAIM` acknowledges the source whose number is in `wdata` bits 4 to 0: that source's `PENDING` bit clears and no other bit changes; a number of `N` or more changes nothing."},
    {"id": "IRQ-SET-WINS", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.3 Clearing", "text": "A source detected at the same rising edge as a write that clears its bit keeps its `PENDING` bit set, so a high-level source acknowledged while its input is still high stays pending."},
    {"id": "IRQ-MASK", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.4 The interrupt and the claim", "text": "`irq` is high exactly when some source has both its `PENDING` and its `ENABLE` bit set, for high-level and rising-edge sources alike."},
    {"id": "IRQ-PRIORITY", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.4 The interrupt and the claim", "text": "`irq_id` is the lowest-numbered source whose `PENDING` and `ENABLE` bits are both set, so source 0 has the highest priority, and it is 0 while `irq` is low."},
    {"id": "IRQ-CLAIM", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.4 The interrupt and the claim", "text": "A read of `CLAIM` returns `irq` in bit 31 and `irq_id` in bits 4 to 0, with every other bit zero."},
    {"id": "IRQ-LATENCY", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.4 The interrupt and the claim", "text": "`irq` and `irq_id` follow the registers with no clock edge, so a source detected at one rising edge drives `irq` until the next."}
  ],
  "items": [
    {"id": "T-PARAM", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_param_upper_bits", "proves": ["IRQ-PARAM"], "rationale": "Run the parameterised testbench at N=2, 8 and 32. Write all ones to ENABLE, MODE and PENDING and drive every src bit high. Check that bits N..31 of each register read zero and that all other directed tests behave the same at each N."},
    {"id": "T-RESET", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_reset", "proves": ["IRQ-RESET"], "rationale": "Load non-zero ENABLE, MODE and PENDING and hold edge sources high, then assert rst_n for one edge. Check that all three registers read zero after reset. Release reset with an edge source still high and check that it sets PENDING once, which shows the remembered level was cleared to zero."},
    {"id": "T-REG-RW", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_enable_mode_rw", "proves": ["IRQ-REG-RW"], "rationale": "Write random and walking-one patterns to ENABLE and MODE. Read each back and compare it with wdata masked to bits N-1..0."},
    {"id": "T-READ", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_read_no_side_effect", "proves": ["IRQ-READ"], "rationale": "Sweep addr 0..3 combinationally with we low and sample rdata in the same cycle as each addr change. Check that rdata matches the selected register and that repeated reads, including reads of CLAIM and PENDING, leave every register unchanged."},
    {"id": "T-LEVEL", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_level_detect", "proves": ["IRQ-LEVEL"], "rationale": "With MODE bit 0, hold src high, clear PENDING by W1C and check that it is set again at the next edge. Pulse src for one cycle and check that PENDING is set and stays set after src falls."},
    {"id": "T-EDGE", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_edge_detect", "proves": ["IRQ-EDGE"], "rationale": "With MODE bit 1, raise src and hold it high. Check that PENDING is set once, and that after a W1C it stays clear while src stays high. Drop and raise src again and check that PENDING is set again."},
    {"id": "T-DETECT-DISABLED", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_detect_while_disabled", "proves": ["IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED"], "rationale": "With ENABLE zero, stimulate level and edge sources. Check that their PENDING bits set while irq stays low, then enable them and check that irq rises."},
    {"id": "T-W1C", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_pending_w1c", "proves": ["IRQ-W1C"], "rationale": "With src low, set a mix of PENDING bits, then write patterns to PENDING. Check that only bits written 1 clear and that writing 1 to a clear bit does not set it."},
    {"id": "T-ACK", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_claim_ack", "proves": ["IRQ-ACK"], "rationale": "With several bits pending, write each source number to CLAIM and check that only that bit clears. Write numbers N..31 and check that no register changes. Also check that wdata bits above 4 are ignored."},
    {"id": "T-SET-WINS", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_set_wins_over_clear", "proves": ["IRQ-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "Acknowledge and W1C a level source whose input is high in the same edge, and check that PENDING stays set. Repeat for an edge source whose rising edge coincides with the clearing write."},
    {"id": "T-MASK", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_irq_mask", "proves": ["IRQ-MASK"], "rationale": "Exercise pending/enable combinations for level and edge sources. A scoreboard compares irq with the OR of PENDING & ENABLE every cycle."},
    {"id": "T-PRIORITY", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_priority", "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY"], "rationale": "Set several pending and enabled sources, including sources 0 and N-1. Check that irq_id is the lowest enabled pending number, and that it moves to the next one after each acknowledge. Check that irq_id is 0 whenever irq is low."},
    {"id": "T-CLAIM", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_claim_read", "proves": ["IRQ-CLAIM"], "rationale": "Read CLAIM in idle and active states. Check that bit 31 equals irq, bits 4..0 equal irq_id, and all other bits are zero."},
    {"id": "T-LATENCY", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_irq_latency", "proves": ["IRQ-LATENCY"], "rationale": "Check that irq and irq_id change in the same cycle as the PENDING or ENABLE update that causes them, with no extra register stage. A source detected at one edge must be visible on irq before the next edge."},
    {"id": "T-SMOKE", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_smoke", "proves": ["IRQ-RESET", "IRQ-LEVEL", "IRQ-MASK", "IRQ-ACK"], "rationale": "Reset, enable one level source, raise it and check irq. Drop src, acknowledge, and check that irq falls."},
    {"id": "A-PARAM", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_upper_bits_zero", "proves": ["IRQ-PARAM"], "rationale": "Asserts that bits N..31 of the ENABLE, MODE and PENDING read values are always zero. Run under formal at several N values."},
    {"id": "A-READ", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_read_no_side_effect", "proves": ["IRQ-READ"], "rationale": "Asserts that with we low, ENABLE and MODE are stable, and PENDING bits can only become set, never cleared."},
    {"id": "A-EDGE", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_edge_needs_rise", "proves": ["IRQ-EDGE"], "rationale": "Asserts that an edge-mode PENDING bit going 0 to 1 implies src was low at the previous edge and is high at this one."},
    {"id": "A-W1C", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_write_never_sets", "proves": ["IRQ-W1C"], "rationale": "Asserts that a PENDING bit going 0 to 1 is always caused by detection on its source and never by a register write."},
    {"id": "A-SET-WINS", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_set_wins", "proves": ["IRQ-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "Asserts that when detection and a clear of the same bit coincide, the PENDING bit is set after the edge."},
    {"id": "A-MASK", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_eq_or_pending_enable", "proves": ["IRQ-MASK", "IRQ-LATENCY"], "rationale": "Asserts combinationally, in every cycle, that irq equals the OR of (PENDING & ENABLE)."},
    {"id": "A-PRIORITY", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_id_lowest", "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY", "IRQ-LATENCY"], "rationale": "Asserts in every cycle that irq_id equals the index of the lowest set bit of PENDING & ENABLE, or 0 when none is set."},
    {"id": "A-CLAIM", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_claim_format", "proves": ["IRQ-CLAIM"], "rationale": "Asserts that when addr is 3, rdata equals {irq, 26'b0, irq_id}."}
  ]
}
=== END FILE ===
